tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt:
One of your pen pals will shortly be visiting your city. For some reasons, you cannot manage to meet her at the airport on time.
Write a email to your pen pal. In your email, Write a letter tell her
Write as much as you can and in complete sentences.
bullets: The reasons why you will be late.
To wait for you at the airport.
tasks.to: One of your pen pals Subject: Apologizing for failing to meet her at the airport on time
tasks.subject: Apologizing for failing to meet her at the airport on time
tasks.sample:
Dear Mary,

I am very much looking forward to your visit to my city, but I regret to inform you that I will not be able to meet you at the airport as soon as you arrive. 

The reason is that your flight will arrive early in the morning, and the quickest I can get to the airport will be about an hour after you land. Please wait for me in the arrival lounge. You should be able to have breakfast there while you wait. 

By the way, as we have never met I must tell you how to recognize me: I am medium height and have a small mustache. In addition, I will be carrying a copy of the morning newspaper tucked under my left arm. Looking forward to out first meeting. 

Yours sincerely
tasks.title: Write an Email
